setlist.title: It Must Have Been The Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews, 1 other source): The pairing with The Music Never Stopped is described as explosive; The transition to The Music Never Stopped is incredible and flows together so well [1][8][14]
- **Comes A Time** (2 reviews): The last part of the song and the remainder of the show use AUD; The last part of the song and the remainder of the show is in AUD [5][6]
- **It's All Over Now** (1 review): The song is described as really rockin, and New Minglewood blues really shines [12]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Instruments align in Bertha and Sugaree, and they really nail it [12]
- **Lazy Lightning** (1 review): Things start fairly average but by this song it really kicks in [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-10-15.167995.ecm280.bertrando.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 171 min [1]
- **gd1976-10-15.fob.sonyecm270.menke.motb-0125.105824.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: This AUD is better than the thin, unbalanced SBD where Bobby is buried [16]
- **gd1976-10-15.sbd.miller.84260.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 165 min; rated 4.8/5 by 15 [3]. Said about its sound: Sound is good, similar to Charlie Miller SB, but AUD patches are less appealing; Reviewer notes a sweet remaster by Charlie and does not mind the aud patches [5][9]
- **gd1976-10-15.sbd.sacks.32060.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 163 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer flew to LA, met a hippie girl at LAX, and shared a ride [7]
- Reserved seat show, but during drums, security let many dance in the aisles [10]
- Reserved seat show, but during drums, security let many dance in the aisles [11]
- Reviewer says this show is better than the previous night's performance [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-10-15.167995.ecm280.bertrando.flac2496**: taped by Rob Bertrando; transferred by Rob Bertrando; source: Sony ECM-280 mics on balcony ledge next to SBD > Sony TC-152 (Sony chrome tape) > Sony TC-755 reel @ 3.75 ips [1]
- **gd1976-10-15.fob.sonyecm270.menke.motb-0125.105824.flac16**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe; source: Sony ECM 270's >> Sony TC 152SD >> [2]
- **gd1976-10-15.sbd.miller.84260.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD D [3]. Also: Patch source recorded by Rob Bertrando; cleaned up flaws and patched tape flips [3]
- **gd1976-10-15.sbd.sacks.32060.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Darrin Sacks; source: MSR>DATs>CDRs>EAC>SHN [4]. Also: EAC extraction and SHN conversion by darrin; notes sector boundary errors on specific tracks [4]
